notes: Baseline of the advanced retrieval pipeline (hybrid + cross-encoder rerank + MMR), measured on golden set v1 at 111 queries (101 scored + 10 adversarial). At 101 scored queries one query is ~1 point, so the gate is ~4.6x more sensitive. The absolute numbers are NOT comparable to the pre-2026-07-14 baseline: the measurement set changed, which is not a regression. Reranker: cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-12-v2.
